description: The pie chart illustrates the time distribution between two key phases in the Paper Copilot system: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart is divided into two segments, with the larger orange segment representing “Reduction,” which accounts for 60.9 seconds (69.92% of the total time), and the smaller blue segment representing “Efficient deployment,” which takes 26.2 seconds (30.08%). The “Reduction” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded outward from the center, drawing attention to its dominant share. Both segments are clearly labeled with their respective time values and percentages, and the chart uses a simple two-color scheme (orange and blue) to distinguish the categories. The overall visual presentation suggests that the majority of the system’s processing time is devoted to the reduction phase, while efficient deployment constitutes a smaller but still significant portion.
